description: 13.01 / 13.09 / 13.10 on the official layout take_and_hold_vs_reconnaissance_1: the home objective area area-large-7 holds a dense ruin and a light ruin, but the converted data parented both ruins to a nearby generator area, so the home area read 'exposed' — INFANTRY in its open ground were never hidden and the area never obscured. With every feature parented to the area it lies in: (A) Boyz in the area's open ground are a legal target for a Custodian Guard ~11.4" away (inside the 15" detection range) but refused for HIDDEN at ~17.4" (explain, get_eligible_targets, the controller's eligible_targets after the player clicks the Guard, and the L overlay's drawn 'Hidden unit' label); (B) a sight line across the area that touches neither ruin is blocked (no_los), as 13.10 requires.

steps.comment: The hot-seat handoff screen is a full-screen CanvasLayer that eats input; acknowledge it the way the player's [Enter] does before driving anything.

Setup: load the official layout take_and_hold_vs_reconnaissance_1 (the fixture's own layout is restored in cleanup). Boyz Gamma (INFANTRY, 10 x 32mm) stand in the OPEN GROUND of the home objective area area-large-7 (x 25.5-37", y 48-55"), touching neither of its ruins; one Custodian Guard (24" Guardian spear) starts ~11.4" away at (18", 57"). Everything else is removed from play; shot stamps cleared so only terrain decides Hidden. The shooter list (which hides shooters with no eligible target) is rebuilt here, while the Boyz are inside detection range.
Frame the Guard and the home area.
steps.script:
var main = tree.current_scene
main.view_zoom = 0.62
var vps = main.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
main.view_offset = Vector2(900, 2080) - vps / (2.0 * main.view_zoom)
main.update_view_transform()
return true

steps.comment: 13.01 / 13.10: the home area holds a DENSE ruin and a LIGHT ruin, so it is a dense (obscuring) terrain area. Before the layout fix both ruins were parented to the generator area area-medium-9 and this area read 'exposed'. Every Boyz model is within area-large-7 and nothing else.

13.09: INFANTRY within a terrain area that contains light/dense terrain features are hidden - in the area's open ground too, not only when touching a ruin. Before the fix this returned 'model m1 NOT hidden'.
Control: ~11.4" is inside the 15" detection range, so the hidden Boyz are a legal target.
steps.script: return RulesEngine.get_eligible_targets("U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B", GameState.create_snapshot(false)).has("U_BOYZ_K")

steps.comment: The Guard steps back to (12", 57"): ~17.4" edge-to-edge, still inside the spear's 24" and with clear terrain sight lines.
Beyond the 15" detection range the rules engine refuses the Boyz for HIDDEN (terrain alone would let the Guard see them).

steps.script: return RulesEngine.get_eligible_targets("U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B", GameState.create_snapshot(false)).has("U_BOYZ_K")
